Wasini Dolphin Tour

Package overview

Experience a magical day at the Kenyan coast with our Full Day Wasini Dolphin Tour. This unforgettable excursion takes you to the pristine waters of the Kisite–Mpunguti Marine Park, home to playful dolphins, colorful coral reefs, and vibrant marine life. The tour also includes a cultural visit to Wasini Island and a delicious Swahili seafood lunch.

  • Wasini Dolphin Tour
  • Dolphin spotting in the Indian Ocean
  • Snorkeling at Kisite–Mpunguti Marine ParkSnorkeling at Kisite–Mpunguti Marine Park
  • Traditional Swahili lunch on Wasini IslandTraditional Swahili lunch on Wasini Island
  • Visit to Wasini Island village & coral gardenVisit to Wasini Island village & coral garden
  • Scenic dhow boat cruiseScenic dhow boat cruise
  • Crystal-clear waters & rich marine biodiversityCrystal-clear waters & rich marine biodiversity

This starts from the south coast, not from Nairobi.

Day-by-day itinerary

01Day 1 | Wasini Dolphin Tour

Experience a magical day at the Kenyan coast with our Full Day Wasini Dolphin Tour. This unforgettable excursion takes you to the pristine waters of the Kisite–Mpunguti Marine Park, home to playful dolphins, colorful coral reefs, and vibrant marine life. The tour also includes a cultural visit to Wasini Island and a delicious Swahili seafood lunch.

What's included

  • Pick-up and drop-off from hotel/airport
  • Entrance fees where applicable
  • Dhow boat excursion
  • Dolphin watching experience
  • Snorkeling at Kisite Marine Park
  • Snorkeling equipment
  • Wasini Island village tour
  • Swahili seafood lunch
  • Professional English-speaking safari guide/driver
  • Bottled drinking water during the excursion

What's excluded

  • Soft drinks, alcoholic beverages, and snacks
  • Personal purchases or souvenirs
  • Optional activities (e.g., guided nature walks, cultural visits)
  • Tips and gratuities for driver/guide
  • Items of personal nature (e.g., jackets, binoculars, cameras)
  • Accommodation before or after the safari
  • Travel insurance or international medical cover

From-prices are planning figures for two adults sharing, in a private vehicle with a guide, at the season shown. Your written quote is the only price that applies. International flights, visas, tips, drinks and gorilla permits are separate unless the quote lists them.
